The installed-wheel restricted-role test registers a versioned Process deployment, accepts routed canonical work, creates and links a Prefect flow run using PostgreSQL table DML grants, and verifies the runtime role has no schema CREATE privilege.

The phase 0.56 operation inventory, OpenAPI snapshots, authorization-order checks, and cross-tenant reconciliation HTTP test cover the added public control.
The historical adaptive 0.52 evidence regenerates and verifies against the new repository source revision.

limitations: This local clean-wheel campaign is not remote CI evidence or a production support commitment.
Only CPython 3.11.15, Prefect 3.7.8, PostgreSQL 16.13, and the Process pool were exercised; other versions, operating systems, hosting modes, and work pools remain unqualified.
The real 30-day retention interval has not elapsed; the live cleanup campaign used a zero-second override while a frozen-clock contract checks the exact configured boundary.

Production and independent third-party connector/backend conformance, broader report-store publication cuts, prolonged outage/backpressure, simultaneous dispatcher/worker failures, and the integrated release decision remain open.
